## Correct Git Flow

You want to work on a feature and raise a PR.

### Which sequence is the best practice?
options: `git push` → `git commit` → create branch → raise PR
`git fetch` → `git checkout feature-branch` → do work → `git stash` → pull latest master → apply stash → resolve conflicts → `git status` → `git commit` → `git push`
`git merge master` → delete repo → raise PR
correctAnswer: `git fetch` → `git checkout feature-branch` → do work → `git stash` → pull latest master → apply stash → resolve conflicts → `git status` → `git commit` → `git push`

## Rebase Concept

Why do teams often use `git rebase` on a feature branch before raising a PR?
options: To rewrite history into a cleaner linear sequence based on latest target branch
To replace all commits with one empty commit
correctAnswer: To rewrite history into a cleaner linear sequence based on latest target branch
